response.text: {"name":"Kopalnica pod zemljo","idea":"The page is a descent into the old mine bathhouse: a coal-black ground lit by one amber lamp colour, the hanging chains and hooks of the rudarska kopalnica drawn in thin lines, and the four beers standing as four tall shafts.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#15110f"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#221c18"},{"role":"text","hex":"#efe6d8"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#a89c8c"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#e8a23a"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#1a1208"},{"role":"border","hex":"#3d332c"},{"role":"band","hex":"#e8a23a"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#1a1208"}],"pairing":"bricolage-public-sans","typeCharacter":"Bricolage Grotesque is chunky and slightly odd, like letters stencilled on a locker door; use it at 800 weight for the h1 at about 11vw in sentence case, 600 for section headings at 4vw and beer names at 7vw, and Public Sans at 400 for running text at 19px with amber only for the phone numeral, the band and rules.","composition":"Section 1 (hero, 6 rows, ground #15110f): h1 'Pivo iz stare rudniške kopalnice' in columns 1 to 9, rows 1 to 3, left aligned, two lines, text #efe6d8; lead in columns 1 to 5, row 4, 19px; one button 'Pokličite' (ground #e8a23a, text #1a1208, square corners) at column 1, row 5. Columns 9 to 12, rows 1 to 6: a line drawing in #e8a23a, thin 1.5px lines, of five chains hanging from a top rule with hooks and simple basket outlines at different heights, bleeding off the top edge of the page. A thin #3d332c rule closes the section. Section 2 (1 row, band #e8a23a): a ribbon of the five words 'Jamar · Šoht · Kopalnica · Smuk · sezonsko pivo meseca' in Bricolage 600, text #1a1208, running once across the full width, left to right. Section 3 (story, 5 rows, ground #15110f): heading 'Jamar, Šoht, Kopalnica in Smuk' in columns 1 to 8, row 1; then four tall panels, each 3 columns wide and 4 rows tall, divided by vertical #3d332c rules, each panel with the beer name at 7vw at the top in #efe6d8 and its style ('Svetli lager', 'IPA', 'Temni porter', 'Pšenično pivo') in Public Sans beneath; the bottom of each panel carries a flat #e8a23a block of a different height, like lamp light at the bottom of four shafts: Jamar one row, Šoht two rows, Kopalnica three rows, Smuk one and a half rows. Pico iz sosednje picerije lahko prinesete s seboj.' in muted #a89c8c below.
